Incomplete and worn Roman coin, copper alloy nummus of Valentinian (AD 364-375) Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece Period 19, AD 364-378. Obverse: Pearl diademed bust, right 'DN VALENTINIANVS PF AVG'. Reverse: Emperor with standard dragging a captive, right, 'GLORIA ROMANORVM' FN in field. Obverse description: Pearl diademed bust, right. Obverse inscription: Illegible.
